limitations: Exact orbits require identical positive influence rows and the closest-point median tie rule.
The nonzero-gap Beta distribution requires independent uniform initial opinions; the polarization-probability formula applies to arbitrary iid atomless initial opinions.
The one-averaging-node consensus statement follows the published general criterion, and the NP-completeness is weak.
Historical priority for rank-one specializations is not independently certified.
